description: Execute all custom rules against code or a file.

code.description: Source code content to analyze directly (maximum 500000 characters; alternative to path). Either path or code must be provided.

language.description: Optional: programming language for filtering rules

path.description: Absolute filesystem path to the file to analyze (maximum 500000 bytes). An empty string is treated the same as omitting the field.

name: execute_custom_rules
